reports.task: Return channel — VPS→laptop reporting (GET /reports pull endpoint)
reports.summary: Built the PULL return channel: reporting/report.py (append_report → REPORTS.md + REPORTS.json, canonical), reporting/report_server.py (stdlib HTTP server :8645, HMAC-SHA256 auth reusing laptop-task webhook secret), trading-reports.service (enabled+running). Verified end-to-end: /health 200, /reports 401 w/o sig + 200 w/ valid HMAC, limit/since params, newest-first ordering.
blockers: SG ingress for :8645 is NOT open: trading-vps-role lacks ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress. Owner must run 'aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress' for tcp 8645 (laptop IP, mirrors 8644 rule) before the laptop can reach /reports over the public internet.
